name: Realm: ancient greenwood (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic old-growth forest photographed on location like a feature-film still - huge oaks and beeches, moss, fern and wildflower meadow, timber houses among the trees, shafts of green-gold light through leaves and soft mist; any magic is a faint glow in new growth
notes: The grass homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/grass/ (set components.realm).
